name: uroboros
description: Zero-inference loop engineering for GitHub Spec Kit. /uroboros:run drives the pipeline from one idea to working code: an independent reviewer questions every phase, each undecided point becomes a question to you, an implementer writes the code on the model and effort you choose, and a verifier uses the built product. --goal swaps the pipeline for a completion condition; /uroboros:compat audits a project's spec-kit.
